title: Figure 7: Cast zirconium-based bulk metallic glass wedge beside a ruler
description: Color photograph of a shiny, elongated metallic wedge resting above a Fairgate steel ruler marked in centimeters and inches. Caption: "Figure 7. Cast Metallic Glass Wedge. Wedge of a zirconium-based bulk metallic glass produced by casting. Note the shiny metallic luster, typical of metallic glasses." It introduces the report's section on metallic glass matrix composites.
